picked: GLM 5.3, 753B parameters at FP8, bespoke licence, central node in the port's own data centre
why: Bespoke licence permits commercial, internal use and redistribution; the command centre role is committed by the requirement; runs on the ontology and memory, not an external service

picked: RF-DETR, Apache-2.0, dock edge tier, about 61 to 68 MB at 16 bit (Nano to Large)
why: Small checkpoints keep pace with the camera stream; the authority holds the weights outright; detection survives an uplink loss

picked: OWLv2, Apache-2.0, site tier, about 310 MB (base) and 875 MB (large) at 16 bit
why: Detects oil sheen, floating debris, smoke or vapour and damage cues on selected frames without port-specific training data

picked: Ministral 3 8B at FP8, Apache-2.0, site tier, about 12 GB
why: Fits the 48 GB PCIe class with room for concurrent requests; a describer and reader of evidence, never a localiser; European publisher suits an EU public buyer

picked: Roboflow trackers (clean-room SORT, ByteTrack, OC-SORT, BoT-SORT), Apache-2.0, dock edge tier
why: Motion and association only, no re-identification branch, chosen on the port's own labelled clips

picked: 141 GB HBM GPU class, eight GPUs per node, one node (1,128 GB)
why: 753 GB of FP8 weights times the 1.2 planning factor is 904 GB, inside 1,128 GB with about 375 GB beside the weights

picked: 48 GB PCIe inference server class, one to four cards, air-cooled, one server at each of the two port sites
why: Sized by memory class, never by product name; one card holds the site models, more cards buy concurrency

picked: GPU-class edge module at each dock, sized by the dock site survey
why: Rated against salt air, wind and temperature; silicon fixed only at the survey

picked: OCP Time Card grandmaster with linuxptp and chrony
why: Frames, telemetry and detections share one clock across tiers

picked: Cameras as payloads on the retained drone fleet (patrol nadir, berth survey, incident response; thermal as an annual trial), dock weather station, drone GNSS and telemetry, pipeline health sensors
why: Detections are geo-located from telemetry against the standardised berth plan

picked: System of Context, with a work surface where the authority's own people build their agents on memory
why: People decide every response; the loop learns through memory, not weight training

picked: Events and evidence crops cross the boundary, not pixels
why: Hours of daily imagery cannot cross the dock uplink, and detection must survive its loss
